sloka: कैः गुणैः अनुरक्ता असि मूढे पण्डित मानिनि ।यः स्त्रिया वचनात् राज्यम् विहाय ससुहृत् जनम् ॥३-४९-१४॥
transliteration: kaiḥ guṇaiḥ anuraktā asi mūḍhe paṇḍita mānini ।yaḥ striyā vacanāt rājyam vihāya sasuhṛt janam ॥3-49-14॥

translations.english: O stupid woman you think you are very wise. What is there in Rama so that you are attached to him ? He has left the kingdom and his kith and kin due to the words of a woman. He has not accomplished anything (in life). He has a limited life span and now lives in this forest haunted by wild animals.
translations.hindi: वध कर अक्तिप्टकमा श्रीशमचन्द्र पहिले हो मयादा भङ्ग कर चुके हे, तो तुम्हीं बतलाओ कि, वास्तव में श्रीरामचन्द्र का इसमें क्या दोप है ?
